BALAAM_Y.name: Balaam
BALAAM_Y.design: Young adult, warm brown skin, narrow face, dark eyes, shoulder-length black curls tied at nape, light beard. Faded indigo tunic, sand sash, dark brown sandals. Lamp carried in left hand unless set down.
BALAAM_Y.performance: warm low-mid register, conversational English, chosen accent held across season

BALAAM_A.name: Balaam
BALAAM_A.design: Same bone structure and eyes, mature adult with fuller beard and weathered indigo mantle. Keep hairline and nose stable; aging shown through grooming and slight eye lines.
BALAAM_A.performance: same performer as youth, slightly slower with age

BEOR.name: Beor
BEOR.design: Lean older man, warm brown skin, short gray curls and beard, olive-brown tunic. Right hand tremor in fine movements, stable across shots.
BEOR.performance: older soft low register, dry humor, brief pauses for breath

HADAN.name: Hadan
HADAN.design: Broad shoulders, square dark beard touched gray, cream tunic, rust mantle, recognizable leather pouch.
HADAN.performance: grounded mid-low register, reasonable business manner

GIRL_CHILD.name: Rescued girl
GIRL_CHILD.design: Child with two short braids and ochre tunic, same face proportions carried into later ages.

GIRL_ADULT.name: Rescued girl grown
GIRL_ADULT.design: Same eyes and ochre palette, braids pinned higher, adult stature; now helps Pethor neighbors.

GIRL_OLDER.name: Rescued girl as mother
GIRL_OLDER.design: Same adult face gently aged, ochre wrap and familiar braid pattern; daughter beside her.

MOTHER.name: Boat mother
MOTHER.design: River-working woman, gray-green wrap, strong forearms, dark hair bound at nape; ages through scenes.

BAKER.name: Baker
BAKER.design: Middle-aged woman in cream work wrap, flour on forearms, green headcloth, direct observant gaze.

NEIGHBOR.name: Neighbor
NEIGHBOR.design: Middle-aged laborer, close dark beard, brown tunic with repaired shoulder.

WOMAN.name: Meadow woman

BROTHER.name: Winter survivor
BROTHER.design: Adult man with short dark hair, red-brown wet tunic under sister's dry wrap.

SON.name: Trapped woman's son
SON.design: Young adult with dark cropped hair, dusty brown tunic, clean memorable jawline.

TRAPPED_WOMAN.name: Woman under roof
TRAPPED_WOMAN.design: Older woman, blue-gray wrap, dust on cheeks, recognizable blue bowl nearby.

CITY_MOTHER.name: Mother in burning city
CITY_MOTHER.design: Dark braided hair, muted red wrap, soot on sleeves, holds boy close.

BOY1.design: Child with short dark curls, tan tunic and bare dusty shins; episode 3 version soot-covered with puppy.

BOY2.design: Child with straight dark hair and dull red tunic; meadow and camp versions use distinct named extras at asset stage.

HEALER.name: Healer
HEALER.design: Older woman with silver-streaked hair, plain brown linen and leather bag; calm efficient hands.

DRIVER.name: Cart driver

FIELD_MAN.name: Field visitor
FIELD_MAN.design: Compact adult with neat beard, ochre-brown tunic and boundary cord.

FIELD_SISTER.design: Strong jaw, gray linen wrap, dark hair plaited along back, animal keeper's callused hands.

BALAK.name: Balak
BALAK.design: Middle-aged king, squared profile, salt-dark beard, wine-red mantle, modest bronze and gold trim.

ENVOY.name: Lead envoy
ENVOY.design: Tall lean mature man, narrow beard, taupe mantle with bronze clasp, richer ceremonial layer for second embassy.

DONKEY.name: Balaam's donkey

ANGEL.name: Angel

ZIMRI.name: Zimri
ZIMRI.design: Adult man in cream tunic with dark red sash, distinct from younger brother.
